definitions.name: O2A.DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'O2A.DC' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD O2A.DC GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest running count of opening minus closing brackets (0 for empty)

definitions.name: O2A.BAL-PREFIX
definitions.body: G0A.BSCAN [ '#' EQ ] MAP 'O2A.PB' BIND O2A.PB O1A.IDX [ 'O2A.PI' BIND O2A.PI 1 ADD 0 O2A.PB O2A.PI GET SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty prefix is)

definitions.name: O2A.FFILL
definitions.body: 'O2A.FV' BIND O2A.FV O2A.FV O1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ G0B.FILLSTEP ] SCAN
definitions.note: V with NILs (one present) -> forward-filled V, leading NILs taking the first present value

definitions.name: O2A.LONGEST-GAP
definitions.note: V with NILs -> length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 when none)

definitions.name: O2A.TAG-COUNTS
definitions.body: [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it, first-appearance order

solutions.orders.unpriced: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0D.WORDS [ G0B.TITLECASE ] MAP G0A.UNWORDS
